moments.title: Premier League Weekend Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The Premier League returns with a packed Matchweek 3 schedule across Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, featuring Ipswich Town vs Liverpool and Arsenal vs Chelsea.

source.l: Premier League Official Site / Sky Sports

angles.name: Friday Night Football
angles.copy: Premier League is BACK! Ipswich Town host Liverpool tonight as Matchweek 3 kicks off. Who are you backing for the win? #PremierLeague

angles.name: Super Saturday Fixtures
angles.copy: Loads of Premier League action tomorrow! Newcastle vs Bournemouth, Man City vs Coventry City, Fulham vs Crystal Palace and more. Get your predictions in!

angles.name: Sunday Showdowns
angles.copy: Big clashes on Sunday with Everton vs Man United, and the London derby: Arsenal vs Chelsea! Who's taking bragging rights this weekend?

moments.title: Bon Jovi Rock Wembley
moments.blurb: Rock legends Bon Jovi play the first of three massive Wembley Stadium shows tonight as part of their 'Forever' tour, their first UK dates in seven years.

angles.name: Tonight's Wembley Gig
angles.copy: It's HAPPENING! Bon Jovi kick off their 'Forever' tour at Wembley Stadium tonight. Expect all the anthems! Who's going?

angles.name: Return to UK Stages
angles.copy: Seven years in the making! Bon Jovi are back on UK soil for three huge shows in London this week. What's your ultimate Bon Jovi track?

angles.name: Classic Rock Anthems
angles.copy: From 'Livin' on a Prayer' to 'Always', Bon Jovi promise a night of iconic rock. Get ready to sing your heart out, London!

moments.title: JAY-Z Takes Over London
moments.blurb: Hip-hop icon JAY-Z is playing two nights in London, starting tonight, bringing his acclaimed live show to the capital.

angles.name: Hova in the House
angles.copy: London, get ready! JAY-Z hits the stage tonight for the first of two anticipated shows. What's the one track you NEED to hear?

angles.name: Hip-Hop Royalty
angles.copy: From 'Empire State of Mind' to '99 Problems', JAY-Z is bringing his legendary catalogue to London. Who's got tickets for tonight or tomorrow?

moments.title: Happy 45th Birthday, Beyoncé!
moments.blurb: Global superstar Beyoncé celebrates her 45th birthday today, September 4th.

angles.name: Queen Bey's Big Day
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 45th birthday to the one and only Queen Bey, Beyoncé! Celebrate her day by blasting your favourite track. What's yours?

angles.name: 45 Years of Iconic Hits
angles.copy: From Destiny's Child to global solo domination, Beyoncé turns 45 today! What's her most iconic moment for you?

moments.title: Dolly Parton's 'Jolene' Re-enters UK Chart
moments.blurb: Following her passing earlier this week, Dolly Parton's iconic hit 'Jolene' has posthumously re-entered the UK Singles Chart at number 9.

angles.name: Jolene's Chart Return
angles.copy: A beautiful tribute. Dolly Parton's timeless 'Jolene' has re-entered the UK Singles Chart at No. 9 following her passing. A true legend.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: 'Jolene' back in the charts reminds us of Dolly Parton's incredible legacy. What's your favourite Dolly song?

moments.title: UK Singles Chart Top 3 Revealed
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holds strong at No. 1 on the UK Singles Chart, followed by Hugel/Imael Angel/Ultra Nate and Ella Langley.

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: Still at No. 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' dominates the UK Singles Chart. What's your current favourite chart hit?

angles.name: New Chart Entries
angles.copy: Hugel/Imael Angel/Ultra Nate with 'Movin' To The Sun' and Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' are making waves in the Top 3 this week!

moments.title: World Cup Qualifiers for Wales & NI
moments.blurb: Wales face Kazakhstan and Northern Ireland play Luxembourg in crucial World Cup Qualifiers tonight.

angles.name: Cymru's Big Night
angles.copy: It's a huge night for Cymru as they take on Kazakhstan in a World Cup Qualifier! Good luck, lads! #TogetherStronger

angles.name: Northern Ireland's Challenge
angles.copy: Northern Ireland are in action tonight against Luxembourg in their World Cup Qualifier. Sending our support! #GAWA

moments.title: Warm Start to September UK
moments.blurb: Parts of the UK are set to experience highs of 26C this weekend as a heat dome impacts southern Europe, before turning cooler next week.

angles.name: Indian Summer Vibes
angles.copy: Enjoy the warmth! Highs of 26C expected in parts of the UK this weekend. Perfect for those last summer vibes before autumn truly kicks in.

angles.name: Autumn on the Horizon
angles.copy: After a warm weekend, temperatures are set to drop next week with more changeable conditions. Time to start thinking about those jumpers?

moments.title: iQFOiL World Championships Begin
moments.blurb: The iQFOiL World Championships kick off in Weymouth, Dorset, on Monday, September 7th, bringing elite windfoiling action to the UK coast.

angles.name: Windfoiling in Weymouth
angles.copy: Get ready for high-speed action! The iQFOiL World Championships start Monday in Weymouth. Who's heading down to watch?

angles.name: Global Watersports Event
angles.copy: The world's best windfoilers descend on Dorset for the iQFOiL World Championships from Sept 7-12. An amazing spectacle on the water!

moments.title: Evanescence UK Tour Kicks Off
moments.blurb: Evanescence begin their UK tour on Tuesday, September 8th, with dates in Leeds, Manchester, Birmingham, and London.

angles.name: Bring Me To Life Tour
angles.copy: Evanescence are back in the UK! Their tour kicks off in Leeds on Tuesday. Who's excited to see Amy Lee and the band?

angles.name: Rocking Around the UK
angles.copy: From Leeds to London, Evanescence are bringing their powerful sound across the UK this week. Which date are you catching them at?

moments.title: Happy 83rd Birthday, Gloria Gaynor!
moments.blurb: The disco queen herself, Gloria Gaynor, celebrates her 83rd birthday on Monday, September 7th.

angles.name: Disco Diva's Day
angles.copy: We will survive! Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Gloria Gaynor on Monday! What's your favourite disco anthem?

angles.name: Iconic Voice
angles.copy: From 'I Will Survive' to 'Never Can Say Goodbye', Gloria Gaynor's voice is iconic. Happy birthday to a true music legend!
